marta_cs: Quick weekly check for Lynx — short summary:

marta_cs: High level: usage down ~18% week-over-week, spend down 12% (contracted seats paused), streaming traffic is ~58% of total RPS.

jason_se: Pulled p95/p99 by route+model (7d window):
jason_se: - /summarize (model-xl-v2) streaming  p95=210ms  p99=480ms ; non-streaming  p95=420ms  p99=1100ms
jason_se: - /chat (model-l2)        streaming  p95=180ms  p99=400ms ; non-streaming  p95=350ms  p99=920ms
jason_se: - /qa (model-mini)       streaming  p95=120ms  p99=260ms ; non-streaming  p95=200ms  p99=520ms

kyle_sre: Noted a transient error spike on 2024-11-12 03:00 UTC affecting cluster-b. 502s and backend timeouts pushed some requests to fallback; overall error rate jumped 0.2% -> 0.9% during incident window.

anya_pm: Renewal risk signal: drop in usage + higher per-token cost due to fallbacks to larger models during the outage. Customer has a renewal decision in ~60 days. Recommend enablement + cost-ops review.

marta_cs: Proposed playbook for next week:
- Enablement session: live walkthrough of streaming integration + best-practice prompts (book Tue 14:00 PT)
- Ops: SRE to verify KV-cache miss causes and adjust routing to prefer streaming for /chat where it shows 2x latency benefit
- CS: Prepare a short cost-impact note and model switch recommendations

kyle_sre: Quick diagnostic logs from the spike (summarized):
kyle_sre: ```
[2024-11-12T03:02:11Z] cluster-b: accept failed, kvcache-miss 12% -> 28%
[2024-11-12T03:02:12Z] fallback: routed to model-xl-v2-quant
[2024-11-12T03:03:05Z] cluster-b: throttling reduced, recovery path applied
```

marta_cs: @jason_se can you generate the p95/p99 chart with separate lines for streaming vs non-streaming per route and drop it in the shared folder before EOD? I'll add it to the enablement invite.
jason_se: Yep — will upload charts + CSV to /shared/lynx/weekly/ and ping here. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident 3124 resolved — fallback policy triggered at 03:03 UTC and automatic rollback applied at 03:12 UTC.

marta_cs: Thanks everyone. I'll schedule the enablement and loop in sales for renewal timeline confirmation (90-day notice). Any blockers?

anya_pm: No blockers from product. Ask sales to confirm renewed seat count and timeline so CS tailors the cost note.

marta_cs: OK — next sync after charts are uploaded.
